title: Fish tank
description: 3 340 fish swim as GPU boids. A device table holds them, a neighbour grid sorts them by cell, and live lists group them by species. A coroutine reads back eaten food. Caustics, bubbles, crumbs and bloom complete the tank.
line: 3 340 boids in a sorted neighbour grid, fed and lit from above.
hint: F feeds · drag to orbit · wheel to zoom
